description: CorePush is a lightweight, dependency-free .NET library for sending server-side push notifications to iOS, Android and Web. It supports the Apple Push Notification service (APNs) over HTTP/2 with token-based (.p8 / JWT) authentication, and Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) HTTP v1 API for Android and Web. Built on the native .NET cryptography stack (no BouncyCastle), it ships thread-safe senders, works with IHttpClientFactory and dependency injection, and lets you plug in a custom JSON serializer.
